episode_summary: Alex Maldonado shares insights on helping first-time homebuyers navigate financial challenges by leveraging seller and lender credits. He discusses effective lead generation strategies, the importance of optimizing your Google business profile, and the value of bilingual marketing. Learn how to provide value to renters and convert them into buyers over time.
